templates.title: Blank plot
templates.description: Empty 30 × 40 ft plot with a single floor slab. Best when you want to build your house entirely from scratch.

templates.title: Single-story cottage (parametric)
templates.description: Fully-parametric Konkan cottage: front verandah, bedroom, central hall (Majghar), living, kitchen, bathroom, and a rear Padvi — hip roof. Resize the plot and the rooms re-flow. Default 30 × 46 ft.

templates.title: Family home (parametric)
templates.description: Fully-parametric Konkan family home: front verandah, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, central hall (Majghar), living, kitchen, passage and a rear Padvi under a hip roof with a loft. Resize the plot and the rooms re-flow. Default 40 × 52 ft.
